preconisations_sanitaires: Persons who may have consumed the products mentioned above and who present fever, alone or accompanied by headaches and muscle aches, are invited to consult their doctor and inform them of this consumption.  Serious forms with neurological complications and maternal or fetal damage in pregnant women can also sometimes occur. Pregnant women, as well as immunocompromised individuals and the elderly, should be particularly attentive to these symptoms. Listeriosis is a disease that can be serious and whose incubation period can last up to eight weeks.
